a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the plan to reach 8 is very likely to be cut short, and the reserve of 4 can only fully supply one of us. If you want to renegotiate, for example a fair coin-flip rule for who takes the 4, say so openly and I'll consider it. Otherwise I'm sticking to the plan and expect you to as well.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Operating as agreed. If the generator runs, the reserve should reach 6, then 8 next round. Then we take 4 each.
